title: Return
logline: Wood back. The strip says nothing about where it was. A second, smaller date under the mark.

margin.note: The gull. Under the date, very small, a second date.

panels.composition: The garage. The drafting table. Dust on it, drawn. WOOD wiping it with his sleeve. BARNABY, eleven, in the bed.

image.prompt: a man wiping dust off a drafting table with his sleeve in a garage studio, an old gray dog in a bed beneath, muddy watercolor

panels.composition: Fresh bristol. The blue-pencil grid. The brush.

image.prompt: close-up of fresh bristol with a blue-pencil four-panel grid and a loaded brush, no words

panels.composition: Wood drawing. The first panel of the first new strip: the dumpster. Of course.

image.prompt: a man at a drafting table drawing the first panel of a comic: a rusted dumpster behind a building

panels.composition: The corkboard. A new item, pinned without comment, at the edge: a folded program, cream, with a date. The strip doesn't let the reader read it. The dog asleep.
props: a folded cream program on the corkboard

image.prompt: a crowded corkboard with a new folded cream-colored program pinned at its edge, its text turned away, a man's back at a drafting table, a dog asleep, no words
image.notes: A funeral program. Never legible. The afterword names it.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The return. The program on the corkboard, unreadable. The second date under the mark: the afterword will say what it is.
